headline: Ramayana could reach 1.37M tickets today and 1.44M tomorrow, with Diwali Sunday; Jailer 2 and Aadarsha Kutumbam are smaller.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 61.9K so far this hour, with 66.4K, 62.7K and 66.9K expected in the next three hours; its busiest hour ahead, 9–10 PM, could reach 96.1K (range 58.2K–144K).

Ramayana's day could reach 1.37M (range 1.14M–1.63M), 20% above yesterday; tomorrow is expected at 1.44M (range 1.07M–1.81M). Positive ratings and word of mouth are offset by nearly full shows, so the net nudge is 0%.
Jailer 2 has 4.3K so far today, with about 1.7K–1.8K per hour expected; its 9–10 PM peak could reach 2.6K (range 1.6K–3.8K), and the day could reach 35.6K (range 29.7K–42.4K), 58% above yesterday.

Aadarsha Kutumbam has 1.3K now, with 1.4K–1.5K per hour expected and a 6–7 PM peak of 1.7K (range 1.1K–2.4K); no full-day or tomorrow figure is available for it. Review and word-of-mouth signals are only collected for films switched on, so Jailer 2 and Aadarsha Kutumbam have none.
watch: Nearly full shows (94% of 1673 upcoming shows) could cap Ramayana's upside, since its positive signals are dropped.
Tomorrow's Diwali figures assume a ×1.12 holiday boost, so a different holiday effect would move the Sunday estimates.
